about: What the world is allowed to cost. The gate reads this file from main, never from the change being judged, so a change cannot raise its own ceiling: raising one is its own framework change and takes effect the day after it lands. Everything here is a count, a byte size or a pixel measure, because a gate that fails on a timing fails on a busy runner.

render.about: Per frame of the hero view, counted from the WebGL calls themselves. Shadow passes count: a mesh that casts a shadow is drawn twice.

live.about: GPU objects alive after the hero frame, on the desktop tier.

leak.about: How many more GPU objects may exist after running the world for this many extra seconds. Zero: a world at rest allocates nothing.

blank.about: A frame is blank when one colour covers more than this share of it, or its brightness barely varies.

determinism.about: Pixels that may differ between two loads of the same build given different wall clocks and different Math.random streams.

docs.about: Instructions grow until nobody can read them. These are ceilings in bytes; recompose instead of appending.
